paragraphs: Swamiji gave unusual advice: bless people when they insult you. Think of the good they are actually doing for you; the only one they can harm is themselves. Even go to places where people dislike you, and let them knock the ego out of you. That, he said, brings you closer to the Lord.

He explained with an image. A mother monkey loves her baby dearly. But if she is standing on an iron plate that is heated until the pain becomes unbearable, she will finally put the baby down and stand on it to save herself.

We hold on to our 'baby', the world, in just the same way, clutching it for as long as we possibly can. Only when life pushes us to the point where we put it under our feet are we ready to come to God.
learn: Criticism stings, but it can also trim an inflated ego and make you stronger. Instead of hitting back, ask what it is teaching you. Sometimes the hardest moments are what finally loosen our grip on things that hold us back.
